_note: List-price snapshot used to price BOTH A/B arms identically (see run_ab.py). Keyed by BARE model name; run_ab.py strips any 'provider/' prefix before lookup, so 'azure/gpt-4o-mini' and 'gpt-4o-mini' resolve to the same row. Directional public list prices (standard on-demand, non-batch, non-cached) — reconfirm against each vendor before publishing a headline scorecard. Grounded 2026-07-27 against the official pricing pages below. IMPORTANT: several 2024-era model ids kept here are now RETIRED or DEPRECATED on their first-party API (see the 'deprecations' block); their numbers are the last-published historical list prices, retained so an unknown-model lookup never hard-errors mid-run — do NOT read them as currently-servable first-party rates. An unknown model is a hard error in run_ab.py (never silently priced at $0).
_deprecations_note: Retired/deprecated first-party ids as of the as_of date. Prices in models{} for these are LAST-PUBLISHED HISTORICAL rates, not currently-servable first-party prices — verify against the listed replacement before using for a live scorecard.

deprecations.o4-mini: Available but sunsetting (succeeded by GPT-5 mini); the dated snapshot o4-mini-2025-04-16 is flagged deprecated. Undated alias still resolves at this rate.
deprecations.claude-3-5-haiku-20241022: RETIRED on the first-party Anthropic API — served only via Amazon Bedrock & Google Vertex at this rate. The benchmark provider map now uses claude-haiku-4-5 ($1/$5).
deprecations.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022: FULLY RETIRED (deprecated 2025-08-13, retired 2025-10-28); first-party calls fail. Value is historical only. The benchmark provider map now uses claude-sonnet-5 ($3/$15 standard; $2/$10 intro through 2026-08-31).
deprecations.gemini-1.5-flash: RETIRED (~2025) — no current official price; endpoint 404s. Value is last-published <=128k-tier list price. The benchmark provider map now uses gemini-flash-latest.
deprecations.gemini-1.5-pro: RETIRED (~2025) — no current official price; endpoint 404s. Value is last-published <=128k-tier list price. The benchmark provider map now uses gemini-pro-latest.
deprecations.gemini-2.5-flash-lite: Servable for existing projects, but 404s 'not available to new users' on newly-created API projects (Google steers new projects to the floating -latest aliases). Kept priced as a historical/existing-project row; the benchmark provider map now uses gemini-flash-latest so any verifier can run it.
deprecations.gemini-2.5-pro: Same new-project restriction as gemini-2.5-flash-lite; kept priced for existing projects. The benchmark provider map now escalates to gemini-pro-latest.
deprecations.deepseek-chat: Deprecated 2026-07-24 — the slug now maps to deepseek-v4-flash (non-thinking mode); price is the current v4-flash standard cache-miss input / output (0.14/0.28). Cache-hit input is lower. Still resolves, so kept as the benchmark's deepseek model.
deprecations.grok-2-latest: RETIRED — not on the official xAI models table; dead slug auto-redirects to grok-4.3. Value is the historical grok-2 list price. The benchmark provider map now uses grok-4.3 ($1.25/$2.50).
deprecations.grok-3-mini: RETIRED — not on the official xAI models table; no 'mini' successor exists. Value is the historical grok-3-mini list price. The benchmark now runs a single grok-4.3 for xAI (no cheap route).

_retired_note: Subset of 'deprecations' that is fully RETIRED / no longer resolves on its first-party API — the benchmark provider map must never target these (a live run would fail). Ids flagged in 'deprecations' but NOT here (o4-mini, deepseek-chat) are deprecated-but-still-servable and are intentionally kept in the map.
